app.name: Jazzar
app.tagline: Ninety years of jazz archives, made askable.

ask.title: Ask the archive
ask.subtitle: Every claim is tied to its source. No source, no answer.
ask.placeholder: E.g. What rating did Kind of Blue receive, and who plays piano on Freddie Freeloader?
examples: Who plays on A Love Supreme?
Summarize how critics' views of free jazz evolved in the 1960s.
Who won tenor saxophone in the 1965 Critics Poll?
What is the average rating of fusion albums compared to hard bop?
ask.redirect_bi: This question is quantitative: it was handed to the Insights engine.
ask.feedback_thanks: Thanks, your feedback trains the router.

explore.title: Explore the archive
explore.subtitle: Hybrid search: semantic + keywords, with exact filters.

dossiers.title: Research dossiers
dossiers.subtitle: A team of agents plans, researches, writes and verifies a sourced deliverable.
dossiers.placeholder: E.g. Prepare a dossier on the Chicago jazz scene between 1965 and 1975: major reviews, emerging artists, social context.

insights.title: Insights — data journalism
insights.subtitle: One question, one verified SQL query, one chart, one reading.
insights.placeholder: E.g. Show how the average rating of free jazz compares to hard bop through the 1960s.
examples: Average rating by genre and decade
Which labels get the best ratings?
How many reviews per year in the archive?

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Indexed documents, by source and type.
library.drop_hint: Drop your PDFs into data/raw/downbeat then run `make ingest-pdf`.

observatory.title: Observatory
observatory.subtitle: Latency, cost, routes, cache and quality (golden set).
